strings.blo_ans:
BLO App is a mobile application created for Booth Level Officers of ECI and its purpose is to facilitate the elections officials as well as citizens. This mobile application is exclusively meant for the Election Commission of India enumerators like BLO, who can use it for multiple purposes like form filling and verification features. BLOs will ensure the facilities available at polling stations and nearby it for voters.
Through this mobile application, the Election officials can view the density of electors’ part wise.
strings.blo_ans_eight:
Yes. In the BLO App, BLO has the provision for filling the forms on behalf of the new elector. BLO will enter details as per the available data of citizens, and BLO can process as per the requirement.
Form 6: New Voter Registration for Ordinary Resident
Form 6A: New Voter Registration for Overseas Voter
Form 6B: Aadhar Collection for Existing Elector/Voter
Form 7: Objection/ Deletion in Electoral Roll
Form 8:Form for Shifting/Correction/Replacement of EPIC/Marking PwD.
strings.blo_ans_five: The device compatibility report in the App is to ensure that the device has all the necessary functionality which will be used on the ground level. For e.g. Camera, Android Version i.e. jellybean, Available Memory, Internet, Available Storage and etc. This is required because the updated version will be more user-friendly and easy to use. Internet will also work properly in the latest device that is why the compatibility check is must before using the app.
strings.blo_ans_four:
These are the following facilities that BLO has to verify.
 PS with Building quality condition
 PS with less than 20 sq meters
 Is PS building dangerous
 Is PS in the government building
 Is PS a religious building/institution
 Is PS a school/college building
 Is PS on the ground floor
 Is PS has separate entry/exit
 Is a political party office within 200 meter of PS
 PS with electricity
 Is shelter available within PS
 PS with proper road connectivity
 Is any obstacle on the way of PS
 Is landline fax available in PS
 Is mobile connectivity available in PS
 Is an internet facility available in PS
 Is PS in insurgency affected area
 Is PS in forest area
 Is PS in the vulnerable critical location
 PS with Permanent ramp
 PS with Drinking water
 PS with Adequate furniture
 PS with signage
 PS with Toilet facility
strings.blo_ans_nine: You should have an android or iOS based smartphone or tablet with a SIM and working mobile connection. The smartphone should have a minimum 5-megapixel camera, 2 GB of free space, and a good battery. Always an external battery power bank is a preferable feature.
strings.blo_ans_seven:
BLO verifies the forms requests which are applied through the Voter Helpline App and Voter Service Portal for the designated (6, 6 A, 6 B, 7, 8). Details will be pre-filled in the forms.
Form 6: New Voter Registration for Ordinary Resident
Form 6A: New Voter Registration for Overseas Voter
Form 6B: Aadhar Collection for Existing Elector/Voter
Form 7: Objection/ Deletion in Electoral Roll
Form 8: Form for Shifting/Correction/Replacement of EPIC/Marking PwD
strings.blo_ans_six: This feature allows the BLO to ensure the necessary facility at/nearby the Polling stations. He has to verify listed facilities and rating for their quality in the form of star rating.
strings.blo_ans_three:
There are 2 main features of BLO App. The features are the following:
1.Integrated BLONet Features:- BLO net features incorporated for making a checklist for BLO and takes action for New Registration for Ordinary Resident, New Registration for Overseas Voter, Deletion/ Objection of Entries, Correction of Particulars in Electoral Roll and Transposition Entry in the same assembly but a different part.
Checklist Requests- 6, 6A, 7, 8
New form submissions - 6, 6A, 7, 8
2. Facility Management:- To verify the available facilities like- Electricity, drinking water, telephone connectivity etc. at the polling station. In the other facility- BLO has to update Nearest Bus stand/ Police station/ Fire station/ Fuel pump data/Hospitals.
strings.blo_ans_two:
First download the Mobile app through the android platform and iOS platform or the user can download from the links below:
In Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.eci.bloapp
In Ios: 
https://apps.apple.com/in/app/bloapp-eci/id6449996333 
After the download User will enter a 10 digit registered mobile number and will click on ‘GET OTP’ and then User has to enter a 6 digit OTP to authenticate by using provided OTP at the registered mobile number to login.

strings.reportAnomalyDisclaimer: Disclaimer: This feature is intended only for reporting suspected anomalies noticed by the BLO during field verification. It should be used only where there is a genuine discrepancy requiring further verification (For example if a BLO knows that an elector is not residing at the address , but the Enumeration form has still been signed by a family member or the age gap between the EROLL and in Aadhaar is too large or any other similar issue.). Reporting an anomaly does not confirm any irregularity; it only flags the case for verification by the ERO/AERO.

 (i) spelling differences between the last and current eRoll, or
 (ii) name mismatch due to addition or omission of middle/last name.
 The letter must mention the EPIC number, elector's name as per current eRoll, and the reason for confirming the mapping.
